Mode of Grouped Data, Class 10 board exam: find the mode for classes 0–10 to 40–50 with frequencies 5, 8, 12, 7, 3.

• Highest frequency is 12, so the modal class is 20–30
• l = 20, h = 10, f₁ = 12, f₀ = 8, f₂ = 7
• Mode = l + (f₁ − f₀)/(2f₁ − f₀ − f₂) × h
• Mode = 20 + (4/9) × 10 ≈ 20 + 4.44 ≈ 24.44
